_comment: Route disposition decisions for the 47 routes the capability matrix could not classify (PR #87, DEC-061). Read by scripts/generate-capability-truth-matrix.mjs; checked by scripts/verify-route-dispositions.mjs.

policy.MIGRATE: The route folds into a named canonical pattern; the capability is carried there.
policy.RETAIN: Functionality remains where it is and adopts the enterprise auth/shell contract.
policy.EXPERIMENTAL: It cannot be marketed as supported until certified or retired.
policy.RETIRED: Deliberately removed; requires a DEC id and a resolving commit.

*.reason: Catch-all route rendering NotFoundPage. It is a shell behaviour, not a capability.
